_about: Structure-data licence of every database that can hold a MateriaViva structure, checked against each provider's own pages on 2026-10-19. class: open = redistribution and commercial use permitted (family: public-domain | attribution | share-alike); noncommercial = redistribution only under NC terms; restricted = redistribution not permitted; unclear = no licence stated, so nothing is granted; unknown = origin not recorded. purchase: true when the provider sells access. Read by scripts/export_open_structures.py; the human-readable summary is DATA_LICENCES_2026-10-19.zh-CN.md.

cod.name: Crystallography Open Database
cod.evidence: All data in the COD and the database itself are dedicated to the public domain and licensed under the CC0 License.
cod.upstream: COD 9xxxxxx ids are AMCSD structures supplied by AMCSD, so they are CC0 here.

tcod.name: Theoretical Crystallography Open Database
tcod.evidence: All data in the TCOD and the database itself are dedicated to the public domain and licensed under the CC0 License.

pcod.name: Predicted Crystallography Open Database
pcod.evidence: All data on this site have been placed in the public domain by the contributors

materials-project.name: Materials Project
materials-project.evidence: By downloading Content from Materials Project, User agrees to accept the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License
materials-project.upstream: Many entries start from ICSD; MP publishes its own DFT-relaxed geometry. Records tagged BY-NC (GNoME r2SCAN subset) are non-commercial; all 154,377 docs in our 2026-07-26 dump are BY-C.

oqmd.name: Open Quantum Materials Database
oqmd.evidence: The data in OQMD is licensed under CC-BY 4.0
oqmd.upstream: ICSD-derived entries are re-relaxed; the SQL dump's unrelaxed inputs are ICSD coordinates and were not used.

alexandria.name: Alexandria Materials Database
alexandria.evidence: Alexandria is available for use under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License.

lemat-bulk.name: LeMat-Bulk (Entalpic; MP + OQMD + Alexandria)
lemat-bulk.evidence: This database is licensed by Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License.
lemat-bulk.upstream: Pool origin, not a source_defs row: 4.27M candidates entered through LeMat-Bulk.

nomad.name: NOMAD Repository and Archive
nomad.evidence: By uploading Content to NOMAD Submitter agrees to and grants third parties the right to use the open access Content on the basis of the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License.
nomad.upstream: Licence is fixed by NOMAD's terms (upload-level field, default CC BY 4.0, admin-only). Our 2026-09-05 export did not record it per entry; an API spot check of 2,000 public entries gave 1,995 'CC BY 4.0' and 5 null. Submitters warrant their rights to inputs.

jarvis-specialized-structures.name: NIST JARVIS specialized structure datasets
jarvis-specialized-structures.evidence: figshare licence field: CC BY 4.0 (all records used)
jarvis-specialized-structures.upstream: Some are JARVIS repacks of third-party data (mxene275 from C2DB, CC BY-SA).

carolina.name: Carolina Materials Database
carolina.evidence: By using the data from Carolina Materials Database, you have to agree to accept the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

snumat.name: SNUMAT hybrid-functional database
snumat.upstream: ICSD compounds, distributed as SNUMAT's own relaxed geometry.

3dsc.name: 3DSC superconductors
3dsc.evidence: The 3DSC_MP database is subject to the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License

aflow-prototypes.name: AFLOW Encyclopedia of Crystallographic Prototypes
aflow-prototypes.evidence: Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0

mc2d.name: Materials Cloud MC2D
mc2d.evidence: Materials Cloud Archive record licence: CC BY 4.0
mc2d.upstream: Monolayers extracted from ICSD/COD/MPDS parents, published by Materials Cloud under CC BY 4.0.

mc3d.name: Materials Cloud MC3D
mc3d.evidence: Materials Cloud Archive record licence: CC BY 4.0
mc3d.upstream: Relaxed structures only; inputs from COD/ICSD/MPDS.

materials-cloud-archive-static.name: Materials Cloud Archive static datasets (zt-z4, 1z-pd, ed-g2, m0-zg)
materials-cloud-archive-static.evidence: rights: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (all four records)
materials-cloud-archive-static.upstream: m0-zg is ICSD-derived but published under CC BY 4.0.

phonondb.name: NIMS MDR phonon database (phonondb)
phonondb.evidence: Rights: Creative Commons BY Attribution 4.0 International

hmof.name: Hypothetical MOF database (JARVIS figshare re-upload)
hmof.upstream: Licence set by the JARVIS re-uploader, not by the original hMOF authors (whose MOFX-DB release states none). Hypothetical structures, no restricted upstream.

mof-carbon-capture.name: Hypothetical MOFs for wet flue-gas carbon capture
mof-carbon-capture.evidence: Materials Cloud Archive record licence: CC BY 4.0

core-mof.name: CoRE MOF 2019 (public ASR/FSR)
core-mof.upstream: CSD-derived; the public archives hold only substantially modified or non-CSD structures.

qmof.name: Quantum MOF Database
qmof.evidence: The data underlying the QMOF Database is made publicly available under a CC BY 4.0 license.
qmof.upstream: CSD-sourced entries are released only as DFT-optimised structures.

fair-mofs.name: FAIR-MOFs
fair-mofs.upstream: RISK: the 45,699 experimental CIFs are curated CSD entries named by refcode, published under CC BY without a stated CCDC permission.

deem-zeolites.name: Deem PCOD hypothetical zeolites v2.1
deem-zeolites.evidence: Zenodo licence: cc-by-4.0 (record by M. W. Deem)

curated-cof.name: CURATED-COFs
curated-cof.evidence: Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy ... without restriction
curated-cof.upstream: Registry URL (lipelopesoliveira/curatedCOFs) is dead; our copy is danieleongari/CURATED-COFs.

phonix.name: Phonix anharmonic phonon database
phonix.evidence: This database is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).

superband.name: SuperBand
superband.evidence: The SuperBand database is subject to the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 License

obelix.name: OBELiX
obelix.evidence: in agreement with the ICSD, we openly publish a set of 292 CIF files for which a normally distributed random noise ... was added
obelix.upstream: Holds no pool structure (id citations only).

c2db.name: Computational 2D Materials Database
c2db.evidence: All CMR databases are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License

cmr-static.name: DTU Computational Materials Repository
cmr-static.evidence: All CMR databases are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License
cmr-static.upstream: CMR withholds ICSD coordinates (zeroed); none of the 33,044 CMR-origin structures here has all-zero coordinates.

bidb.name: 2DHub van der Waals Bilayer Database
bidb.evidence: All CMR databases are licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License

gnome.name: GNoME
gnome.evidence: available for use under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution Noncommercial 4.0 International Licence

elementa.name: ELEMENTA and ELEMENTA Spin
elementa.upstream: No commercial licence is offered publicly.

icsd.name: Inorganic Crystal Structure Database
icsd.evidence: Information obtained from the database must not be passed on to any third parties or unauthorized users.
icsd.upstream: Paid annual licence; even licensed, at most 10-20 records may be passed on.

rruff.name: RRUFF
rruff.evidence: Selling, distributing, publishing, circulating, or commercially exploiting the data in this database without the express written permission of the owners of the data is expressly prohibited.

iza-zeolite.name: IZA Database of Zeolite Structures
iza-zeolite.evidence: The data are copyright protected, but can be used free of charge for private purposes

amdb.name: Anyterial Altermagnets Database
amdb.evidence: Individual database entries, and non-substantial sets of them ... are available under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license.
amdb.upstream: Holds no pool structure (id citations only).

aflow.name: AFLOW
aflow.evidence: No current data licence; until ~2014 the site said CC BY 3.0 'at no charge only for fair use'.
aflow.upstream: The ICSD catalogue also ships the original ICSD geometry (geometry_orig).

odbx.name: Open Databases Integration for Materials Design
odbx.evidence: No data licence on the site or OPTIMADE /info.
odbx.upstream: ODBX states no licence. Its CAMD and Wren entries are re-attributed by native id to their own licensed releases (keys camd, wren); law-gnn (1,707, ids cite ICSD prototypes) and odbx_main (56) stay unclear.

materiae.name: Materiae
materiae.evidence: © 2018-2026 Copyright: Institute of Physics Chinese Academy of Sciences

amcsd.name: American Mineralogist Crystal Structure Database
amcsd.evidence: Free download with a citation request; no licence.
amcsd.upstream: The same structures are in COD (9xxxxxx) under CC0.

sacada.name: Samara Carbon Allotrope Database
sacada.evidence: Copyright notice and citation request only.

openmx-2d-ab2.name: OpenMX AB2 2D structure map
openmx-2d-ab2.evidence: No licence; points to Mater. Adv. 2, 4392 (2021).

mofx-db.name: MOFX-DB
mofx-db.evidence: 'freely accessible' with no licence on the site, paper or repo.
mofx-db.upstream: Redistributes CoRE MOF, hMOF, ToBaCCo, IZA, PCOD-syn.

omdb-organic.name: Organic Materials Database
omdb-organic.upstream: Structures are COD entries; our copy is a JARVIS re-upload labelled CC BY 4.0 by the re-uploader. Re-sourcing from COD by id would make them CC0.

hadb.name: Hard-coating Alloys Database
hadb.evidence: Data will be made available on request.

spse.name: Solid-electrolyte screening platform
spse.evidence: The crystal structure data are mostly extracted from the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD)
spse.upstream: 91,688 of 91,763 structures are ICSD entries relabelled CC BY without FIZ permission. Holds no pool structure (id citations only).

legacy-local.name: Legacy local pool (unique_structs_all, merged before provenance tracking)
legacy-local.upstream: 1.85M candidates with no recorded origin; admitted only when an open database independently holds the structure.

camd.name: CAMD 2022 coarse-grained discovery set (Ye, Lei, Aykol, Montoya), via ODBX
camd.evidence: figshare licence field: CC BY 4.0 (checked via the figshare API 2026-10-19)
camd.upstream: Entries we took from ODBX whose native id starts camd- (camd-camd_*, camd-oqmd_*).

wren.name: Wren coordinate-free coarse-graining set (Goodall et al.), via ODBX
wren.evidence: Zenodo licence: mit-license (checked via the Zenodo API 2026-10-19)
wren.upstream: Entries we took from ODBX whose native id starts wren-scn-.
